text: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information, ensuring we comply with UK data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018.

How We Use Your Information Lists purposes with lawful bases (e.g., responding to inquiries about our L-2HGA clear Staffy puppies ; providing info on Staffordshire Bull Terrier breeding dogs ; website improvement; legal compliance).
Third-Party Services We work with reputable providers such as The Kennel Club and DEFRA-approved pet transport services.
We also use Google Analytics for analytics.
For more about your data rights in the UK, visit ICO.org.uk .
This includes using secure servers, data encryption (SSL), restricting access to personal data, and regular staff training.

We may share your data only in the following limited circumstances: 01 With trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website, conducting our business, or serving you, provided those parties agree to keep this information confidential (e.g., website hosting, email communication platforms).

02 If arranging DEFRA pet transport for your puppy, necessary personal details will be shared with the approved, third-party transport service to facilitate the safe and compliant delivery of your new family member.
03 When legally required to do so, for example, in response to a court order or other legal process.

Your Rights Regarding Your Data (GDPR & Data Protection Act 2018) As a UK resident, you have significant rights regarding your data: Right to Access You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
You also have the right to complain to the UK’s supervisory authority for data protection, the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO).
You can find more information on their website: www.ico.org.uk .
For general guidance on your data rights, you can also visit Citizens Advice or GOV.UK Data Protection .
We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
